title: Getting Started with Edge AI
description: The centralized entry point for Infineon's Edge AI offerings: tools, ready-to-use Edge AI solutions, model development packages and accelerators, and pre-trained models for PSOC™ and AURIX™ hardware and other Infineon microcontrollers.
long_description: Edge AI is the process of developing small and efficient machine learning models intended for running at the edge of the system close to the events happening. Typically you want to run these models locally, you need fast response times and they are intended to run in smaller devices. In Infineon we typically are talking about microcontrollers e.g. PSOC™, AURIX™, TRAVEO™ families.
